findings.detail: Theorem reproduced with premises P1-P6. Within CFG179's own scope (a law that keeps a sqrt regime at the scale in question) only an ownership-type nonlocal composition escapes: A4a. The wording 'only B escapes' omits that laws which are Newtonian/linear at the scale (screened, r-dependent laws such as Arm B and the chain; linear-in-source laws) also have zero residual; they escape by not having the sqrt pull there. It also omits premise P2 (universal free fall / difference rule): E7 is a composition outside P2 and still has an EFE (A4d).
